# note: SUPPLEMENTARY comparator, not part of Rustle's rule: the translated protein search (T3: mmseqs easy-search --search-type 2, protein identity >= 0.30, e <= 1e-5, max(query, target coverage) >= 0.50) added to the direct nucleotide alignment (T1 asm20 identity >= 0.80; T2 asm20 -k11 -w5 identity >= 0.60; coverage >= 0.50), human A119b chr16 (the development chromosome; score.py spectrum); never run genome-wide (hours, >= 13 GB per sample)
# note: recall rows: Compara pairs whose two genes both have a locus in the chr16 assembly, by Compara protein identity band; view edge_asm20 = T1, edge_nt = T1 or T2, edge_nt_protein = T1, T2 or T3

# note: precision rows: aligned locus pairs above each tier's floor, judgeable (both genes have Compara data), in bands of the tier's own identity (nucleotide for T1/T2, protein for T3); 'all' = pooled
# note: ci = Wilson 95% (treats pairs as independent; they are not)
